pm2_tie_handling_convention: Gallery ranking uses Python Timsort descending by calibrated ensemble score (sorted(gallery_scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)), preserving deterministic insertion order of expected_chars on exact ties. Missing/undetected eligible probe faces or empty other-scene galleries (score == -1.0) count as incorrect under intention-to-treat (rank = N_gallery + 1, reciprocal rank = 0.0).
